_meta.description: Gujarat district & sessions court formatting rules — drives cause-title, party designations, prayer language, verification format
_meta.change_protocol: CLO sign-off required for any change. Vishal raises Jira tickets to Ajay for additions; never edits unilaterally.

designation: IN THE COURT OF DISTRICT & SESSIONS JUDGE
jurisdictionNote: District-level criminal and civil courts in Gujarat. Sessions courts try offences punishable with imprisonment exceeding 7 years. District courts handle civil suits, execution proceedings, and appeals from subordinate courts. City Civil & Sessions Court, Ahmedabad operates under the Bombay City Civil Court Act, 1948 (as adopted in Gujarat). Designated Special Courts handle Atrocities, POCSO, NDPS and PMLA cases.

party_designation.state: State of Gujarat through the Principal Secretary, Home Department, Government of Gujarat, Gandhinagar

case_nomenclature.anticipatory_bail: Criminal Misc. Application (For A. Bail) No. _____ of {year}

prayer_language.opening: It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: And for this act of kindness, the applicant shall, as in duty bound, ever pray.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, the applicant above named, do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath that the contents of the above application from paragraph ___ to paragraph ___ are true to my personal knowledge and the contents of paragraphs ___ to ___ are believed to be true on the basis of information received and legal advice, which I believe to be true. Nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Solemnly affirmed at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT
localRules: Bail applications under S.483 BNSS must disclose any earlier rejection by the Magistrate or any co-ordinate court.

Anticipatory bail applications (S.482 BNSS) must be accompanied by an affidavit and a certified copy of the FIR; Gujarat HC practice requires applicant to ordinarily exhaust the Sessions Court remedy first.
Vakalatnama with court-fee stamp of Rs. 5 to be filed at the first instance per the Gujarat Civil Manual.
Plaints to be valued under the Bombay Court Fees Act, 1959 as in force in Gujarat; ad valorem fee schedules apply.
All civil pleadings to be paginated, indexed and accompanied by a list of documents under Order VII / Order VIII CPC.
Gujarati is the official language of the subordinate courts in Gujarat under the Gujarat Official Language Act, 1960; English pleadings are accepted but translations may be insisted upon.
Atrocities (SC/ST), POCSO and NDPS cases are tried by designated Special Courts notified by the State Government in the District HQ; PMLA cases go to the PMLA Special Court at Ahmedabad.
Service via the Court bailiff is supplemented by registered post AD; substituted service requires a specific order under Order V Rule 20 CPC.
e_filing_note: e-Filing operational at major district HQs (Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot) via eCourts portal; not yet mandatory state-wide.
